description: This script filters fonts.xml to include only desired font packages based on categories, and can output a list of font files for GYP build configuration.

methods.name: SelectFont
methods.description: Filters font nodes based on package category, weight, and style.

methods.name: FilterFonts
methods.description: Recursively filters font nodes in the XML document, removing unwanted nodes.

methods.name: GetContainerName
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the container name of a node of a given type.

methods.name: DoMain
methods.description: Main function parsing command-line arguments, filtering fonts.xml, and outputting results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point executing DoMain with command-line arguments.
